description: This file implements functions for importing and verifying Nostr profile events, including fetching profile data from relays, sanitizing URLs to prevent SSRF attacks, and merging profiles. It defines interfaces, constants, and functions related to profile import operations in a Nostr client context.

methods.name: sanitizeProfileUrls
methods.description: Sanitizes URLs in a profile to prevent SSRF attacks by removing unsafe URLs.

methods.name: importProfileFromRelays
methods.description: Fetches the latest kind:0 profile event for a pubkey from relays, verifies, and parses it.

methods.name: mergeProfiles
methods.description: Merges a local profile with an imported profile, preferring local data when available.
